description: This nullable cycle fixture bounds observation sharing with a close family (engine §4.1).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision
%rule text $c:candidate %conditions $c.without-elision-except(fam).matches(rival)
%rule candidate {r} B
%rule rival {s} B
%rule r r [+T] | X
%rule s s [+T] | X
%rule fam s
